name: SearchTable

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the tenant ID, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic

parameters.help_en: The type of the environment to which databases belong. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163309.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据库的环境类型，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163309.html
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en:
The scope of tables that you want to query. Valid values:

HAS_PERMSSION: the tables on which the current account has permissions.
OWNER: the tables owned by the current account.
MY_FOCUS: the tables that the current account follows.
UNKNOWN: all tables
parameters.help_zh:
权限范围，取值和说明：
HAS_PERMSSION：有权限的
OWNER：我Owner的
MY_FOCUS：我关注的
UNKNOWN：不限
parameters.name: search_range

parameters.help_en:
The type of table that you want to query. Valid values:

TABLE: physical and logical tables
SINGLE_TABLE: physical tables
LOGIC_TABLE: logical tables
parameters.help_zh:
搜索表类型，取值如下：
TABLE：表，包含物理表和逻辑表
SINGLE_TABLE：物理表
LOGIC_TABLE：逻辑表
